day_shape: 63 items: Pakistan's Sharif claims US-Iran peace framework agreed with signing within 24 hours while Tehran's MFA pushes back, IDF says 70+ Hezbollah sites struck in south Lebanon with mass evacuation orders for 20+ villages, Rubio-Jaishankar call on Strait of Hormuz, heavy regime messaging on the 12-day war anniversary.

threads.label: Pakistan-brokered US-Iran framework claim
threads.summary: Pakistani PM Sharif said the US and Iran had agreed a framework to end the conflict with a final text reached, while Iran International reported a deal could be days away. Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Baghaei said on IRIB that the Islamabad understanding focuses on ending the war, excludes the nuclear file at this stage, and will not be signed tomorrow.

threads.label: South Lebanon strikes and evacuation orders
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck over 70 Hezbollah sites in south Lebanon in the past day and killed seven operatives from a tunnel near the 551st Paratroopers Brigade's sector, while IDF Arabic spokesman Adraee issued evacuation orders for some 20 villages around Nabatieh. Lebanese media reported the Lebanese army withdrew from Kfar Tebnit; Defa Press claimed Israeli forces pulled back from the same crossing after Hezbollah attacks.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz diplomatic and naval activity
threads.summary: State Department said Secretary Rubio spoke with Indian EAM Jaishankar on recent events in the Strait of Hormuz and stressed commercial vessels must comply with US Navy orders, while CENTCOM posted footage of fighters launching from USS Abraham Lincoln in the Arabian Sea. Defa Press argued no pipeline can replace Hormuz volumes; Jerusalem Post reported analysts citing legal backlash to Iranian missile and drone strikes on Bahrain and Kuwait.

threads.label: Iranian nuclear stockpile reporting
threads.summary: Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reported Iran has fortified and booby-trapped entrances to a bombed nuclear site holding enriched uranium as negotiations continue. IRIB cited a Bloomberg estimate that Tehran has rebuilt around three-quarters of its pre-war missile arsenal during an eight-week ceasefire with the US.

threads.label: 12-day war anniversary messaging in Tehran
threads.summary: President Pezeshkian, parliament speaker Ghalibaf, judiciary chief Ejei, interior minister Momeni and Khatam al-Anbiya commander Abdollahi marked the first anniversary of the 'imposed 12-day war' on IRIB and Defa Press, with Ejei saying Iran has 'absolutely no trust' in the Americans. Khamenei's office posted on the Persian-language day and on tree-planting, and Defa Press ran an extensive martyrs package alongside a tribute to nuclear scientist Fereshteh Bagheri.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral arrangements announced
threads.summary: Defa Press and Khamenei's office published Notice No. 3 of the commemoration committee setting the time of the farewell and funeral procession for 'martyred Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei'. Defa Press also reported the pardon of 139 death-row convicts approved by the Supreme Leader, with security offences excluded.

threads.label: Iraqi Shia factions and regional posture
threads.summary: Defa Press carried Asaib Ahl al-Haq leader Qais al-Khazali warning that dissolving the Hashd al-Shaabi would damage Iraq's capability and urging passage of the PMF law on its 12th anniversary. The outlet also quoted Baghdad Friday prayer leader Ayatollah Mousavi telling Iraqis to draw on Iran's experience in preserving national independence from US and Israeli influence.

events.summary_en: Pardon of 139 death row convicts with the approval of the Supreme Leader of the Islamic Revolution. Asghar Jahangiri, spokesman for the Judiciary, announced the pardon of 139 death row convicts with the approval of the Supreme Leader of the Islamic Revolution and said: Security criminals have been removed from the pardon list. At a time when many countries refrain from granting pardons during crises and war, the Islamic Republic of Iran, with an approach based on Islamic compassion, has provided the conditions for a number of convicts to benefit from pardon and reduction of punishment. Those who had a role in security crimes and recent events were not included in this pardon and were exempted from the pardon list from the beginning. dnws.ir

In light of Hezbollah terrorist party's breach of the ceasefire agreement, the Israeli Defence Force is forced to act against it forcefully. The Israeli Defence Force does not intend to harm you.

For your safety, you must immediately evacuate your homes and relocate north of the Litani River.

Anyone near Hezbollah elements, its facilities and combat means will put their life in danger!
